name: next-luas
title: Next Luas
description: Live tram times for Dublin's Luas. Finds your closest stop via GPS and shows inbound and outbound forecasts in real time.
author: darrenmaher

commands.name: next-luas
commands.title: Next Luas
commands.subtitle: Dublin Tram Times
commands.description: Show live tram times for your closest Luas stop.

preferences.name: manualLat
preferences.title: Manual Latitude
preferences.description: Pin the extension to a fixed latitude (e.g. 53.3257 for Dublin city centre). Overrides GPS. Leave blank to auto-detect.

preferences.name: manualLng
preferences.title: Manual Longitude
preferences.description: Pin the extension to a fixed longitude (e.g. -6.2680). Overrides GPS. Leave blank to auto-detect.
